INSERT INTO d360.STG_EDS_BOB_TBLFUNC_SELECT_SRC
(
                 APP_LOG
                ,BO_FO_FLAG
                ,CD
                ,DSCP
                ,HAS_ALERT
                ,HAS_PAYEE_MNT
                ,HAS_TXNLIMIT
                ,HELP_FILE
                ,HREF
                ,ID
                ,IMG_HREF
                ,IS_AUDITABLE
                ,IS_AVAILABLE
                ,IS_BASE_FUNC
                ,IS_ENABLE
                ,IS_IMPORT
                ,IS_MENU
                ,IS_MVA
                ,IS_NOTIFIABLE
                ,IS_PRICING
                ,IS_SERVICE
                ,IS_SYSAD
                ,IS_WF
                ,LVL
                ,OVRD_FLAG
                ,PARENT
                ,SEQ_NO
                ,SEQ_NO_CD
                ,TITLE
                ,WF_ROLE_FLAG
                ,BNK_CODE
                ,FILE_NAME
				,JSRC_FLG 
				,JTAR_FLG 
)
			SELECT 				
                 CC.APP_LOG
                ,CC.BO_FO_FLAG
                ,CC.CD
                ,CC.DSCP
                ,CC.HAS_ALERT
                ,CC.HAS_PAYEE_MNT
                ,CC.HAS_TXNLIMIT
                ,CC.HELP_FILE
                ,CC.HREF
                ,CC.ID
                ,CC.IMG_HREF
                ,CC.IS_AUDITABLE
                ,CC.IS_AVAILABLE
                ,CC.IS_BASE_FUNC
                ,CC.IS_ENABLE
                ,CC.IS_IMPORT
                ,CC.IS_MENU
                ,CC.IS_MVA
                ,CC.IS_NOTIFIABLE
                ,CC.IS_PRICING
                ,CC.IS_SERVICE
                ,CC.IS_SYSAD
                ,CC.IS_WF
                ,CC.LVL
                ,CC.OVRD_FLAG
                ,CC.PARENT
                ,CC.SEQ_NO
                ,CC.SEQ_NO_CD
                ,CC.TITLE
                ,CC.WF_ROLE_FLAG
                ,LEFT(CC.FILE_NAME,5) AS BNK_CODE
                ,CC.FILE_NAME
		        ,0 AS JSRC_FLG 
				,1 AS JTAR_FLG 
			FROM EDS.BOB_TBLFUNC CC
            JOIN d360.STG_EDS_BOB_TBLFUNC B
            ON CC.ID  = B.ID 
            AND LEFT(CC.FILE_NAME, 5) = LEFT(B.FILE_NAME, 5)
			WHERE CC.ISLATEST = '1';
	


TRUNCATE TABLE d360.STG_EDS_BOB_TBLFUNC_GROUP_SRC;

INSERT INTO d360.STG_EDS_BOB_TBLFUNC_GROUP_SRC
(

select 
                 APP_LOG
                ,BO_FO_FLAG
                ,CD
                ,DSCP
                ,HAS_ALERT
                ,HAS_PAYEE_MNT
                ,HAS_TXNLIMIT
                ,HELP_FILE
                ,HREF
                ,ID
                ,IMG_HREF
                ,IS_AUDITABLE
                ,IS_AVAILABLE
                ,IS_BASE_FUNC
                ,IS_ENABLE
                ,IS_IMPORT
                ,IS_MENU
                ,IS_MVA
                ,IS_NOTIFIABLE
                ,IS_PRICING
                ,IS_SERVICE
                ,IS_SYSAD
                ,IS_WF
                ,LVL
                ,OVRD_FLAG
                ,PARENT
                ,SEQ_NO
                ,SEQ_NO_CD
                ,TITLE
                ,WF_ROLE_FLAG
                ,BNK_CODE
				,FILE_NAME
				,JSRC_FLG_CNT 
				,JTAR_FLG_CNT
				,CAST(LEFT(RIGHT(FILE_NAME , 12), 8) AS DATE) FILE_DATE
from 
(
	SELECT 				
                 APP_LOG
                ,BO_FO_FLAG
                ,CD
                ,DSCP
                ,HAS_ALERT
                ,HAS_PAYEE_MNT
                ,HAS_TXNLIMIT
                ,HELP_FILE
                ,HREF
                ,ID
                ,IMG_HREF
                ,IS_AUDITABLE
                ,IS_AVAILABLE
                ,IS_BASE_FUNC
                ,IS_ENABLE
                ,IS_IMPORT
                ,IS_MENU
                ,IS_MVA
                ,IS_NOTIFIABLE
                ,IS_PRICING
                ,IS_SERVICE
                ,IS_SYSAD
                ,IS_WF
                ,LVL
                ,OVRD_FLAG
                ,PARENT
                ,SEQ_NO
                ,SEQ_NO_CD
                ,TITLE
                ,WF_ROLE_FLAG
                ,BNK_CODE
				,MAX(FILE_NAME) FILE_NAME
				,SUM(JSRC_FLG) AS JSRC_FLG_CNT 
				,SUM(JTAR_FLG) AS JTAR_FLG_CNT
	FROM d360.STG_EDS_BOB_TBLFUNC_SELECT_SRC
	GROUP BY 					
                 APP_LOG
                ,BO_FO_FLAG
                ,CD
                ,DSCP
                ,HAS_ALERT
                ,HAS_PAYEE_MNT
                ,HAS_TXNLIMIT
                ,HELP_FILE
                ,HREF
                ,ID
                ,IMG_HREF
                ,IS_AUDITABLE
                ,IS_AVAILABLE
                ,IS_BASE_FUNC
                ,IS_ENABLE
                ,IS_IMPORT
                ,IS_MENU
                ,IS_MVA
                ,IS_NOTIFIABLE
                ,IS_PRICING
                ,IS_SERVICE
                ,IS_SYSAD
                ,IS_WF
                ,LVL
                ,OVRD_FLAG
                ,PARENT
                ,SEQ_NO
                ,SEQ_NO_CD
                ,TITLE
                ,WF_ROLE_FLAG
                ,BNK_CODE
	HAVING ( SUM(JSRC_FLG) > 0 AND SUM(JTAR_FLG) = 0 ) OR ( SUM(JSRC_FLG) = 0 AND SUM(JTAR_FLG) = 1) 
) AS TEMP


DECLARE @PREVIOUS_BUSINESS_DAY AS DATE
SELECT @PREVIOUS_BUSINESS_DAY = PREVIOUS_BUSINESS_DAY FROM EDS.DATE_DIM 
INNER JOIN (SELECT TOP 1 CAST(LEFT(RIGHT(FILE_NAME, 12), 8) AS INTEGER) MX_DT FROM [d360].[STG_EDS_BOB_TBLFUNC]) MX_DT_TBL
ON DATESK = MX_DT;	


UPDATE A
SET
SCD_END_DATE = @PREVIOUS_BUSINESS_DAY
, ISLATEST = 0
FROM EDS.BOB_TBLFUNC A 
INNER JOIN d360.STG_EDS_BOB_TBLFUNC_GROUP_SRC B ON
COALESCE(A.ID,'-1') = COALESCE(B.ID,'-1')
AND COALESCE(A.BNK_CODE,'-1') = COALESCE(B.BNK_CODE,'-1')
AND A.ISLATEST = 1
AND B.JTAR_FLG_CNT = 1

                ,SRC.HAS_ALERT
                ,SRC.HAS_PAYEE_MNT
                ,SRC.HAS_TXNLIMIT

                ,SRC.HREF
                ,SRC.ID
                ,SRC.IMG_HREF
                ,SRC.IS_AUDITABLE
                ,SRC.IS_AVAILABLE
                ,SRC.IS_BASE_FUNC
                ,SRC.IS_ENABLE
                ,SRC.IS_IMPORT
                ,SRC.IS_MENU
                ,SRC.IS_MVA
                ,SRC.IS_NOTIFIABLE
                ,SRC.IS_PRICING
                ,SRC.IS_SERVICE
                ,SRC.IS_SYSAD
                ,SRC.IS_WF
                ,SRC.LVL
                ,SRC.OVRD_FLAG
                ,SRC.PARENT
                ,SRC.SEQ_NO
                ,SRC.SEQ_NO_CD
                ,SRC.TITLE
                ,SRC.WF_ROLE_FLAG

				,'9999-12-31'
				,1
				,1
				,LEFT(SRC.FILE_NAME,5)
				,'BOB'
				,SRC.FILE_NAME
				,CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
FROM d360.STG_EDS_BOB_TBLFUNC_GROUP_SRC SRC
WHERE JSRC_FLG_CNT > 0
